pr_title: add base repo resolution to `gh repo delete`

issue_context.title: support base repo resolution in repo delete
issue_context.body: `gh repo delete` should work with no argument as long as it's executed from a git repository that has been pushed to a github host.

review_comments: I think this test case still has value, it just no longer is an error case but a success case where the `RepoArg` is a blank string.

In the `DeleteOptions` defined on line 28 we will also need to specify 
`BaseRepo: f.BaseRepo` else when we call `opts.BaseRepo()` at line 72 it will be undefined. Unfortunately, with how we do tests, overriding `BaseRepo` this is a hard case to catch since it is defined when running tests but not when running normally.
